# Planned API outage Oct 16 5:30 - 6:30 pm PST

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (10/4/2023):

There is a Keycloak upgrade planned for Monday Oct 16, 2023 from 17:30 - 18:30.  This will result in an outage of API services and no access to the new BC Registry application in Production during this brief time.
To prepare for this upgrade, the API sandbox environment may not be available on Oct 10 from 17:30 - 18:00 for testing.
